candidate_role: Evasive Specter with discard or bounce trigger
commander_specific_hypothesis: Whenever Blizzard Specter deals combat damage to a player, choose either to return a permanent that player controls to its owner's hand or to make that player discard a card. Crosis can separately trigger its own paid color-based discard ability on combat damage.
expected_benefit: Adds a flying Specter that advances the deck's primary discard plan and offers tempo interaction when bounce is preferable.
tradeoff: Loses Brotherhood Regalia's ward {2} and limited evasion support. Crosis already flies and Lightning Greaves remains for protection/haste.
